product_one_liner.value: Marquee is an AI-powered football intelligence platform for professional clubs that combines their internal and external data to support recruitment, squad planning, performance analysis and tactical decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage and product page describe the platform and its club use cases.

pricing_page.notes: The public site navigation/footer provides product, about, FAQ, news and demo links but no pricing link or public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Marquee identifies Reading FC as a long-term official intelligence-layer partner and says it is the official intelligence layer of Club Atlético Lanús.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 19 employees; that count falls within the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies New York, NY as headquarters and gives a primary New York address.

founded_year.notes: The company profile lists 2025 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The news index includes product, partnership and press items, but does not show two technical build-focused posts by engineers; the identified architecture post is a single such item.

public_docs.notes: The site has a single FAQ page with Q&A entries, but no public product documentation, help center or developer portal linked from its site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: LinkedIn lists a Senior AI Scientist role at Marquee as a recent active posting.

model_provider.notes: The product page and FAQ describe proprietary AI/ML models but do not name a model or AI provider; no public provider disclosure was found in the reviewed product, FAQ or news materials.

compliance_certs.notes: Marquee publicly says it completed its SOC 2 Type II audit.

last_funding.notes: The July 30, 2026 announcement reports a $4 million seed round; it distinguishes the round from the $6.5 million total raised to date.

raised_18mo.notes: The seed round announced July 30, 2026 falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The recent active posting is Senior AI Scientist. The other located Marquee listing, Head of Football Department, is closed and is not a sales role; no active SDR, BDR or account-executive posting was found.

launched_6mo.notes: On July 14, 2026, Marquee announced that SkillCorner users could access new Physical and Game Intelligence tracking data through the platform for player reports, discovery and opponent analysis.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company’s full listed leadership roster shows its co-founders and current senior leaders; no C-level or VP-level join or departure within the stated window was identified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public FAQ discusses the platform and data-provider compatibility but names no CRM or sales/marketing system.
